name: Taki Taichi
source:
Nanbu's classmate. A red-haired pony-tailed playboy with green eyes. Is friendly with Nanbu and his chief interest is flirting with females. Dumb and spends his time tearing around Kyoto looking for pretty tour guides, maikos and mikos.
